answer: Bonded random juries: each new identity posts a refundable bond and must pass karst-like layered audits before its grades count. Jurors are drawn at random, so a whisper of fake accounts rarely lands on the same jury, and a dune of Sybils must lock one bond per fake that gets slashed when their colluding grades diverge from honest consensus. Attacker cost: bond times number of fakes, plus total loss once caught.
